contexts: regional cancer centre with eight disease-site clinics
about 1,900 new patients with advanced solid tumours a year
palliative care clinic capacity of about 30 new patients a week
two recorded searches returned no records
reading: Referral now depends on one decision by a busy oncologist; triggers move that decision into the record, with the oncologist able to opt out. The expected effect runs through an earlier first visit to symptom control, care planning and fewer admissions at the end of life, but clinic capacity limits how many extra referrals can be absorbed. Both recorded searches were empty, so every evidence node here is an unchecked lead.
